published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

rotation: Start with 0 Rage. Before the pull, Battle Stance, Charge (15 Rage) and back to Berserker Stance. Battle Shout comes from the raid
Sunder Armor as the first GCD. Every warrior does this, and the tanks keep it up after
Death Wish in the last 36s, Recklessness in the last 30s
Blood Fury and Berserking in the last 30s. Elune's Light on cooldown, but never during Recklessness or the 15s before it. Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, the second in the last 20s
Bloodrage under 20 Rage. Berserker Rage under 30 (Improved Berserker Rage)
Bloodthirst, then Slam at 45+ Rage right after a main-hand swing, then Whirlwind at 25+ Rage
During execute, Execute comes after Bloodthirst and Whirlwind. Putting it first loses 4.7 DPS on Fury and 22.7 on two-hand Fury
Heroic Strike at 90+ Rage, outside execute
caveats: The trinket's last use is saved for the last 34s.
Assumed: white hits give Rage by weapon speed, at the level 30 rate even at level 60.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Heroic Strike stops at rank VIII, and the raid's Battle Shout at VI, Strength of Earth at IV and Grace of Air at II.
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is for white hits only. Heroic Strike can trigger Unbridled Wrath.
Only one +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 12.0 DPS.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece isn't counted. It would add 8.8 DPS vs Humanoids.
Saving Death Wish for the last 36s adds 17.4 DPS at 180s and 28.4 at 120s.
Rage from taking raid damage (2 hits a minute, about 9 Rage each) is an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_arms -apl level60_fury_2h -talents 30305013032-25053000142210501 -race Orc -duration 180, unedited (mksettings sets the raid hits, 2 a minute at 1500). Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts. Uses the Fury class options (Berserker Stance) as the preset build does; the preset's DefaultConsumes keep an off-hand stone, which has no effect without an off hand. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull, and the preset's own pull Sunder is the raid's other one.
